name: wholesale-b2b
label: Wholesale & B2B Business Leaders
description: Targets VP/Director/C-suite leaders at wholesale, distribution, and B2B businesses who could buy NetSuite ERP, eCommerce (SuiteCommerce, Shopify), and integration services. Secondary criteria — useful for expanding AOTT's client base beyond agency partners and retail brands.
_wholesale_b2b_guidance:
Score wholesale/distribution/B2B leads on two axes — platform signal and seniority — rather than a single confirmation gate:

**Platform confirmed (strong, current):** Company explicitly uses NetSuite/SuiteCommerce, or Shopify Plus for B2B/wholesale ordering — signal in their current role, company About, or tech stack ('we run on NetSuite', 'migrated our B2B portal to SuiteCommerce'). Any qualifying title becomes eligible for warm-to-hot. Past-role mentions do NOT count.

**Platform implied (B2B-native or modernizing, no explicit mention):** Wholesale/distribution/manufacturing company with evident digital-transformation or B2B eCommerce signals: customer/dealer portals, EDI or API integration projects, ERP modernization, multi-warehouse or multi-currency operations. Only qualifies at C-suite or VP level (CEO, COO, CFO, CTO, CIO, VP Operations, VP eCommerce) — score as low warm (45-55).

**No signal:** Generic wholesale/distribution company with no digital or ERP signal, or below Director-level seniority — classify cold regardless of title.
_excluded_employers_note: This criteria targets people at wholesale, distribution, and B2B businesses. Employees of ERP/eCommerce platform vendors themselves (Shopify, Oracle/NetSuite, Salesforce, SAP, Adobe, Microsoft, BigCommerce, Infor, Epicor, Acumatica) are not wholesale/B2B businesses and not leads — classify cold, cap score at 25, regardless of seniority. Detect from the headline when company fields are null: 'at Shopify', '@ NetSuite', 'at Infor'.
_excluded_companies_note: Operator feedback 2026-06-09 (SuiteDB), 2026-07-27 (Seibert Consulting Group), 2026-08-06 (AnagramDev), and 2026-08-06 (FullClarity - no fit for AOTT despite being a genuine NetSuite partner), and 2026-09-10 (Techfino - same 'no fit despite scoring well' pattern, also removed from any reference_companies list it appeared in): absolutely no interest in engaging with these agencies under any circumstances - never surface anyone from these firms in any tier, in any criteria. Unlike excluded_employers (surfaced cold), these are dropped entirely at Step 2 - skip the result AND write it to seen.json so it never resurfaces. Detect from headline naming the firm; Seibert Consulting Group's staff may abbreviate as 'SCG' in headlines (e.g. 'at SCG') - treat that alongside any Seibert/NetSuite/Shopify Plus context as the same exclusion. Operator feedback 2026-08-12: N2Lab is now an active AOTT client relationship - exclude from all criteria and never surface as a new lead, regardless of fit.
